## About
A-Z Tech Automotive is a family owned and operated shop in Mission Viejo. We do auto body and collision repair, engine and transmission work, brakes, and the everyday maintenance that keeps a car running well.
Amir and his family have called Orange County home for a long time, and his passion for cars began in London, England. He enjoys working with customers every day and making sure they leave happy. Ken manages the shop, and his policy is simple: honesty and integrity first, focusing on what is best for the customer.
Customers mention Amir, Ken, Robert, Jeff and Junior by name in their reviews. Whether it is a dent, a warning light or a scheduled service, we will explain what your car needs and take care of it.

## Services
- Auto body and collision repair: Collision, bumper, dent and frame repairs, windshield and glass work, and auto body painting.
- Engine repair: Full engine repairs, plus cooling systems, water pumps, radiators, wiring and electrical work.
- Transmission repair: Transmission repairs and maintenance for all makes and models.
- Brake repair: Brake and cylinder repairs.
- Oil and filter change: An oil and filter change with the right oil for your vehicle.
- Factory scheduled maintenance: Factory scheduled maintenance as an alternative to the new-car dealer.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work on all makes and models and accept all insurance carriers. One reviewer said we coordinated everything with his insurance and the claims adjuster.

Q: Do you guarantee mechanical repairs?
A: Yes. We guarantee all parts and mechanical repairs for 2 years or 24,000 miles.

Q: Can I drop my car off before you open or after you close?
A: Yes, we offer late night and early bird drop-off. Fill out a folder by the door, seal your keys inside, and put it through the mail slot on the door.

Q: What if my car will be in the shop for a while?
A: For longer term repairs, Enterprise Rental Services is right here onsite.
